result.summary: Reviewed git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex against lib/letflow/design/iss0721-entity-event-type-seeding.md. Findings: (1) Idiomatic/OTP -- new maybe_seed_entity_event_types/2 uses the same false/true clause-match style as its sibling maybe_seed_platform_event_types/2; no state machine or process concerns apply here. (2) Supervision -- not implicated; no process spawned or collapsed. (3) Type-safety -- no new class of invalid state introduced; the {:error, {:event_type_seed_failed, term()}} tuple is consistent with the module's existing {:error, {:migration_failed, Exception.t()}} convention, and the @spec union was widened by exactly the one member the design flagged as a mechanical pre-existing gap (tenant_provisioning.ex:364-371's @spec previously omitted a shape maybe_seed_platform_event_types/2 could already produce). No type-safety issue worth filing to docs/issues/. (4) Scope creep -- none: implementation is the minimal wiring specified (one private function placed immediately after maybe_seed_platform_event_types/2, one new with-clause using already-bound schema_name/using_default_manifest? values, one @spec widening); no undesigned additions. Precedent consistency: mirrors ISS-0072's maybe_seed_platform_event_types/2 shape exactly, with the one documented and justified divergence (schema_name argument instead of tenant_id, required by EventTypes.seed!/1's own @spec) rather than an invented pattern. No contradiction with any docs/migration/decisions/ record. Gate: PASS.
